description: A test script for git merge operations involving case-insensitive filesystems, verifying behavior of renaming files with case changes during merge.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites needed to run the test, specifically if the filesystem is case-insensitive.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file after the merge operation.
